issue.title: test_zero_link_selection_is_pixel_identical_to_no_rail_at_all differs at PNG byte 35 under host load, passes alone
issue.description:
Two captures of one running app (link rail cleared vs. rail unmounted) should be
byte-identical PNGs, but under host load they differ at PNG byte 35. Reported by two
phases of epic sase-11y.10.1, both reproducing it on trees without their changes.

- sase-11y.10.1.2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #7, 2026-09-20): batched with the axe,
  axe_runs, axe_descriptions, axe_layout, link_rail and help_panel visual modules via
  `just fix-tui-screenshots --check -- <those six modules>`, it failed 3 of 3 on
  ec7dbbfdf + that phase and 2 of 3 on a pristine export of origin/master 8bb6e2ec1 (no
  service_host change). Run alone it passed 6 of 6 on the phase tree and 5 of 6 on the
  pristine tree. Host load1 was 23-32. Failure: `assert cleared_png == unmounted_png`.
- sase-11y.10.1.4 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #2, 2026-09-21): failed on clean HEAD in a
  baseline worktree during the full suite.

Likely cause: the test compares two renders of a live app, so any late paint (clock,
countdown, spinner, or rail teardown settling) between captures changes the bytes.
Neither report found a code change that caused it.

task_type_fields.evidence: Proposed by sase-11y.10.1.2 note #7 and sase-11y.10.1.4 note #2. Batched under load: 3/3 fail on a phase tree, 2/3 fail on pristine origin/master 8bb6e2ec1. Alone: 6/6 pass on the phase tree, 5/6 pass on the pristine tree. Failure: assert cleared_png == unmounted_png, differing at PNG byte 35.
